items.criterion: An uploaded chapter image exists in the bucket at the key naming its content digest.
items.judgment: Read the object store for the key the upload response named.

items.criterion: Media of an unpublished case file stays unreadable to a request with no session.
items.judgment: Request the media route with no bearer token and read the answer.

items.criterion: An unpublished case file is missing from the public list and from its own public address.
items.judgment: Read the public list and the public case file route for a draft slug.

items.criterion: Publishing an approved case file places it at the end of the grid order and in the public list.
items.judgment: Publish through the transition route and read the public list back.

items.criterion: Publishing the changes of a published case file moves the pending copy to the public address.
items.judgment: Rewrite the description, publish the changes and read the public case file.

items.criterion: Two approvals of one submitted case file admit exactly one approval and one conflict.
items.judgment: Drive two approvals through a barrier and read the two answers.

items.criterion: A visitor session reaches no console endpoint.
items.judgment: Call each studio endpoint with a visitor token.

items.criterion: An author session is refused every editor-only endpoint with the protected state unchanged.
items.judgment: Call the grid order, the inbox, the outbox, the export and the examples as an author.

items.criterion: An author reaches no case file another account owns.
items.judgment: Read, write, publish and delete another author's case file.

items.criterion: The rows a reader sees in the interface are the rows in the database and the objects in the bucket.
items.judgment: Compare the public case file against its stored row and its stored object.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous sign-ups for one address create exactly one account.
items.judgment: Drive two sign-ups through a barrier and count the stored accounts.

items.criterion: A submit runs every gate first and lists each failure under its field.
items.judgment: Submit an empty case file and read the refusal body.

items.criterion: A returned case file carries its note and becomes writable for its author again.
items.judgment: Return a submitted case file and read the stored note and state.

items.criterion: A change to a published case file waits in the pending copy while the public reads the published text.
items.judgment: Rewrite a published case file and read the public address.

items.criterion: A chapter order request rewrites every position from the complete list.
items.judgment: Reverse a chapter list and read the stored positions.

items.criterion: A write carrying a stale version is refused as a version conflict.
items.judgment: Save twice from one version and read the second answer.

items.criterion: The first title save derives the case file slug from the title.
items.judgment: Save a title and read the slug that comes back.

items.criterion: A slug that has ever been issued is never issued again.
items.judgment: Delete a case file and create another with the same title.

items.criterion: A valid enquiry is stored with its fields and the state new.
items.judgment: Send an enquiry and read the stored row.

items.criterion: An invalid enquiry is refused field by field with nothing stored.
items.judgment: Send each invalid field in turn and count the stored enquiries.

items.criterion: An enquiry writes one message to its sender and one to every editor.
items.judgment: Send an enquiry and read the outbox.

items.criterion: A reset link works once and closes every session of its account.
items.judgment: Complete a reset twice and call a protected route with the old token.

items.criterion: Five failed sign-ins lock further attempts for that account.
items.judgment: Sign in wrongly five times and then with the right password.

items.criterion: Every response carries the pinned security headers.
items.judgment: Read the headers of a public address.

items.criterion: Every public address answers one application document carrying its own preview tags.
items.judgment: Read the served markup of each public address.

items.criterion: A notice body keeps only paragraphs, lists, links and emphasis runs.
items.judgment: Save a notice body carrying a script and read what survives.

items.criterion: The seeded studio carries its accounts, sectors, clients, notice rows and example case files once.
items.judgment: Count the seeded rows in the database.

items.criterion: A confirmed visitor keeps a shortlist that survives a repeated write.
items.judgment: Add and remove one case file twice and count the stored entries.
